text: The water in the second floor bathroom smells terrible and has been like this for three days.
There is no electricity in room 204 since last night. We cannot study.
A man was standing near the back gate at 11 pm and the guard was not there. I felt unsafe.
The wifi is very slow in the evening, it takes forever to load anything.
Dal was too salty today and the rice was undercooked.
The corridor on the ground floor has not been swept for a week, there is dust everywhere.
Students in the next room play loud music until 1 am and we cannot sleep before exams.
पानी आएको छैन दुई दिन देखि। कृपया चाँडो मिलाइदिनुहोस्।
The kitchen staff spoke very rudely when I asked for more dal.
The bathroom door lock on the first floor is broken, it does not close properly.
Thank you for fixing the geyser so quickly, the hot water is working well now.
A senior student has been repeatedly making inappropriate comments to me and I am scared to report it openly.
